title: Filament module manifest semantic block v1
description: The optional `semantic` block of a filament module manifest (quoin FR-070): the fields a module declares to describe itself as a semantic-core package. Every field is fcd's own vocabulary, referenced by $ref rather than restated, so this block cannot skew from the target and package-identity definitions it draws on. Module install policy (compatibility posture, legacy-form handling, sweep reports) is quoin's, not fcd's, and is out of scope for this schema. Property names are snake_case to mirror the module manifest's own on-disk keys, unlike this directory's camelCase package-manifest/mapping/profile documents.

contract_version.description: Semantic-module contract version this block conforms to; 1.0.0 for quoin FR-070, like every other v1 contract's const contractVersion in this directory.

semantic_core.description: Exact @agent-ix/semantic-core version the module compiles against.

package.description: This module's own package identity in the semantic-core package graph.

exports.description: Object-type names this module publishes as semantic types; each must also be declared in the manifest's object_types.

imports.description: Imported semantic packages, keyed by package identity, pinned to the exact version this module compiles against.

targets.description: Generated targets and representation formats this module's semantic types compile to, drawn from fcd's own declared target registry. Always a $ref; never a locally inlined enum.

mappings.description: Named representation mappings this module declares (quoin FR-071..073).
